records.scope: Flask application implementing the soundcloud.com mirror: the dark #121212 header (logo, Home/Charts/Library nav, scored search bar, Sign in / Create account / Upload actions), the anonymous marketing landing with hero sections, the logged-in Home with Top 50 / New & Hot / trending-by-genre / curated sections, the charts landing (US + UK chart playlist cards), chart and curated playlist pages with ranked 50-row track lists, artist profiles with banner/avatar header, info stats, tabs and track grids, track pages with real waveforms, like/repost/share actions, comment threads with at-timestamps, related tracks and in-playlist panels, scored site-wide search with Everything/Tracks/People/Playlists tabs, tag browse pages, auth (sign in / sign up / sign out), the library (likes, playlists, following, listening history), profile settings, the Go / Go+ / Next Pro plans page with the subscription checkout chain (card validation, plan switching, confirmation receipt), the creator upload flow (creates a live track page under the uploader's profile), fetch-based like/repost/follow/comment/playlist/play-record actions, and the 404/500 handlers.

Deterministic build-time and boot-time seeder. All content rows come from the tracked source_data/ snapshots; every seed function early-returns on a populated DB, every date is pinned relative to MIRROR_DATE (2026-09-26) and the schema is created with a deterministic index order so the SQLite seed is byte-reproducible on every build. Benchmark users use a frozen password digest.

Frozen snapshots of the live api-v2.soundcloud.com as served on 2026-09-25/26: 1,249 real tracks (titles, artists, durations, play/like/repost/comment counts, genres, tag lists, descriptions, labels, licenses, release dates, publisher metadata and 180-sample waveform data from wave.sndcdn.com), 855 artist profiles (usernames, followers, followings, track counts, bios, cities, verified and Next Pro badges), 38 playlists (the 20 US/UK Music Charts Top 50 playlists plus 18 SoundCloud-curated playlists with their real ranked track lists, likes, reposts and descriptions), 10,371 real comments (bodies, authors, timestamps, created dates), the 20-genre trending taxonomy, and the real Go / Go+ / Next Pro plan prices from the payments quotations API.
Per-file inventory (bytes, SHA-256, upstream source URL) for every managed image under static/images/; enforced by the image build's check_asset_inventory.py gate.
Real track artworks served by i1.sndcdn.com at the t500x500 transform (the size the live track pages render), one per seeded track.

Real artist avatars served by i1.sndcdn.com at the t200x200 transform, one per seeded artist, plus the upstream default avatar (a1.sndcdn.com/images/default_avatar_large.png) shared by artists and commenters who have none.
Real artist header visuals served by i1.sndcdn.com at the t1240x260 transform, one per artist whose profile has one (230 artists).
Real playlist cover artworks served by i1.sndcdn.com at the t500x500 transform, one per seeded playlist.
Real commenter avatars served by i1.sndcdn.com at the t50x50 transform (the size the live comment threads render), one per unique seeded commenter.
The SoundCloud cloud logo SVG exactly as inlined in the live site's header markup.

Hand-written stylesheet reproducing the captured soundcloud.com design language (dark #121212 background, #f50 accent, #999 secondary text, Söhne/system font stack, fixed header, card grids, ranked track lists, waveform bars, artist banner headers, plan cards, fixed playbar, modal, footer).

Client state machine: playbar queue with simulated playback over real track durations (progress, seek, next/prev, volume), fetch-based like/repost/follow/comment/add-to-playlist/remove actions with live count updates, the add-to-playlist modal, and play-event recording for the listening history.

Jinja templates reproducing the captured upstream layout: base chrome (header, search, playbar, footer), marketing landing, Home, charts landing, chart/curated playlist pages, artist profiles, track pages with comment threads, search tabs, tag browse, auth pages, library views, user playlist management, settings, plans/checkout/receipt, upload, and 404/500 handlers.

Pytest suite: health contract, core-page rendering, 50-row chart coverage, scored multi-word search, search tabs, benchmark-user fixtures (likes/follows/playlists/history/subscriptions), auth flows, like/comment/follow toggles with DB persistence, user-playlist CRUD, play-event history, subscription switching, upload chain, waveform+artwork integrity for every seeded track, playlist owner/artwork integrity, and 404/auth guards.

The capture and build pipeline (gitignored outputs): Playwright recon of the live site surfaces, the api-v2 scrape passes (chart selections, curated selections, playlist resolves, per-track metadata for stubbed rows, artist profiles, artist top tracks, comments, waveforms, banners, plan quotations), build_source_data.py curating the tracked source_data/ snapshots, download_assets.py fetching every real upstream image and writing asset_inventory.json, dev-server helper, interaction probe, DOM fidelity probe, and the 21-task browser walk verifier.
Resumable raw upstream captures (gitignored, never shipped): rendered page HTML for every mirrored surface, the raw api-v2 JSON responses, and reference screenshots of the live site.
